tools.name: site_info
tools.description: Orientation: who Mash Prime is, what the site covers, when to use it, and every page — returned as markdown (the site's llms.txt).

tools.name: list_posts
tools.description: List all published blog posts with slug, title, description, and publication date, newest first.

tools.name: read_post
tools.description: Read the full markdown text of one blog post by slug (get slugs from list_posts).

tools.name: search_posts
tools.description: Search blog posts by keyword across titles, descriptions, and full text. Returns matching posts with a snippet.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_posts, read_post, search_posts · Public sink: read_post.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_posts, read_post, search_posts · Public sink: read_post

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
